title: ACTH (adrenocorticotropic hormone)
what: This blood test checks the hormone the brain uses to control the adrenal glands.
why: When cortisol is too high or too low and the doctor needs to find the cause: in the adrenal glands or in the brain.
duration: the blood draw takes a few minutes; results usually come in a few days
tell_doctor: If you take steroid hormones as tablets, shots, inhalers, or creams
If you take vitamins or supplements with biotin. It can affect the result
If you work night shifts. It affects the test time

prepare.title: Timing
prepare.text: Blood is usually taken early in the morning, on an empty stomach. Plain water is fine.

prepare.title: Rest
prepare.text: The day before: no alcohol, workouts, or stress. Sit quietly for a few minutes before the draw.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop anything on your own. Tell your doctor what you take. They will decide if anything needs to change before the test.

prepare.title: Clothing
prepare.text: A sleeve you can easily roll up above the elbow.

bring: Your referral or list of tests
A list of your medicines, including creams and inhalers
steps: You sit quietly for a few minutes
A band is tied above your elbow, and you are asked to clench your fist a few times
The skin is wiped with antiseptic
A quick prick. Blood fills the tubes in a few seconds
The needle comes out, and a cotton pad is pressed on the spot
The tube is put on ice right away and sent to the lab quickly
feel: A quick prick, like a pinch
Sometimes slight dizziness. Tell the nurse, and they will help you lie down
after: Press the cotton pad for 3 to 5 minutes
You can eat and take your morning medicines, if your doctor said so
The doctor looks at the result together with your cortisol
red_flags: The puncture site is very swollen, painful, and red

faq.q: Why must the test be done in the morning?
faq.a: ACTH changes a lot during the day. It is highest in the morning, so it is easier to compare with normal values.

faq.q: Can steroid creams affect the result?
faq.a: They can. Be sure to tell your doctor about them. They will decide what to do.

reminders.text: ACTH test tomorrow. Early morning, on an empty stomach. No alcohol or workouts this evening.
